description.zh: 剧组色盘：跨镜跨集的色彩一致性靠「机械注入同一字符串」实现，不靠每次重新描述。primary 为主色（4 个，锁定不变），extended 为扩展色（上限 2 个，仅用于情绪转折场次）。生成任何图像/视频提示词时，把 paletteLine 逐字粘贴到 STYLE 块，不得改写、缩写或重新排序。
description.en: Production color palette: cross-shot and cross-episode consistency comes from mechanically injecting the same string, not from re-describing it each time. primary holds the four locked colors; extended allows at most two, used only in emotional-turn scenes. When composing any image or video prompt, paste paletteLine verbatim into the STYLE block — never rewrite, abbreviate, or reorder it.

primary.zhRole: 全局暗部基调；阴影与夜的默认色
primary.enRole: Global shadow base; the default for night and darkness

primary.zhRole: 主光与中间调；冷静、疏离、日常
primary.enRole: Key light and midtones; calm, detached, everyday

primary.zhRole: 高光与暖点；记忆、希望、旧物
primary.enRole: Highlights and warm accents; memory, hope, aged objects

primary.zhRole: 危险与血的低饱和替代；冲突、伤害、警示
primary.enRole: A desaturated stand-in for danger and blood; conflict, injury, warning

extended.zhRole: 仅用于「扭曲/腐败」主题场次
extended.enRole: Used only for distorted or decay-themed scenes

extended.zhRole: 仅用于「回忆/梦境」主题场次
extended.enRole: Used only for memory or dream-themed scenes

paletteLine.zh: 色盘：夜色近黑 #0E1A24 / 冷青 #1F4E5F / 旧金 #C9A227 / 暗砖红 #8C3A2E。所有画面统一使用这四色为基调，禁止出现这四色之外的主体颜色；色温整体偏冷，高光只用旧金，不要暖白。
paletteLine.en: Palette: night near-black #0E1A24 / cold teal #1F4E5F / antique gold #C9A227 / dark brick red #8C3A2E. Every frame is built from these four; no subject color outside them; overall color temperature cool, highlights only antique gold, never warm white.

emotionColorMap.zhColor: 冷青为主，暗部占 60% 以上
暗砖红进入画面，冷青与红形成对撞
emotionColorMap.enColor: brick red enters the frame, clashing against the teal

emotionColorMap.zhColor: 整体降饱和，旧金收至最小面积，大面积冷青与近黑
emotionColorMap.enColor: desaturate overall, shrink gold to a minimum, large areas of teal and near-black

emotionColorMap.zhColor: 旧金面积上升为主高光，暗部仍保留冷青
emotionColorMap.enColor: gold grows into the main highlight while shadows keep the teal

emotionColorMap.zhColor: 近黑扩展到 75%，冷青压成边缘轮廓光
emotionColorMap.enColor: near-black expands to 75%, teal compressed into rim light

zh: 1. 声明：本文件的 primary 是全片唯一色彩事实源；
2. 复用：每次生成提示词都粘贴 paletteLine 原文，不得由模型或人重写；
3. 扩展：extended 只允许在情绪转折场次使用，且一个场次最多引入一个；
4. 校验：每集出片后抽查 3 个镜头的主色占比，偏离本表即判定漂移，回到第 1 步重新对齐。
en: 1. Declare: the primary colors in this file are the film's single source of color truth;
2. Reuse: paste paletteLine verbatim into every prompt — never let a model or a human rewrite it;
3. Extend: extended colors are allowed only in emotional-turn scenes, at most one per scene;
4. Verify: after each episode, sample three shots and check primary color share; drift means returning to step 1 to realign.
